executive_summary.next_step: Within 24 hours, confirm whether GPI and British American Tobacco price moves correlate with Strait of Hormuz transit disruption or broader energy/input cost shock; escalate if either supplier has hedging or working-capital exposure to oil or gas.
executive_summary.context: The Strait of Hormuz transit collapse and 131% gas premium above baseline, combined with 23% aluminium elevation, signal acute commodity-supply stress. GPI (High exposure, -4.4%) and Smoore (Critical exposure, -4.4% on 12 Nov) both posted unexplained drops; British American Tobacco today fell 4.7% on 3× normal range. Drought alerts across EU and USA may compound aluminium and energy tightness.
